title: Telescopic cascode OTA
description: A single-branch telescopic cascode: an input pair, an input (NMOS) cascode, a load (PMOS) cascode, and a load mirror stacked between the rails, all carrying half the tail current, plus the tail source. Cascoding multiplies each side's output resistance by the cascode intrinsic gain, so $A_v = g_{m,in} * R_{out}$ with $R_{out}$ = par(NMOS side, PMOS side) and each side's $R_{out} \approx A_{v0,casc} / g_{ds}$ of the device it cascodes. That is the topology's headline: the highest single-stage gain per unit current, bought with output-swing headroom — the four stacked $V_{dsat}$ plus the tail eat the rail. The five stacked devices place five internal nodes; each cascode $V_{DS}$ is an estimate param with a stack-consistency guardrail (the drops must sum to the rail). The cascode-pole and settling behaviour is estimate-grade; sim owns sign-off.

params.name: swing_target
params.note: required single-ended output swing (peak) about the output DC

params.name: CM_dc
params.note: nominal input CM at which the operating point is evaluated

params.name: V_out_dc
params.note: output DC level; the NMOS drops below it and the PMOS drops above it must each close the rail

params.name: sign_p
params.note: vds sign convention of the PMOS-side tables: +1 for an N-style axis, -1 for a signed-PMOS axis

params.name: gm_id_in
params.note: input-pair inversion: sets gm per current and the input-referred noise

params.name: gm_id_casc
params.note: cascode-device inversion: higher gm/ID lifts the cascode gain av0_casc but costs vdsat headroom

params.name: gm_id_mir
params.note: load-mirror inversion: lower gm/ID adds less noise and offset

params.name: vgs_est_in
params.note: estimate of the input-pair vgs, used to place the tail node; retune until input-bias-consistent is green

params.name: vds_in_est
params.note: input-device vds (drain node above the tail source); a stack-consistency guardrail ties it to the rail

params.name: vds_cn_est
params.note: input-cascode vds (output node minus the input drain)

params.name: vds_cp_est
params.note: load-cascode vds magnitude (its source node minus the output)

params.name: vds_mir_est
params.note: load-mirror vds magnitude (VDD minus the load-cascode source node)

doc.title: Input-pair device
doc.description: Half-circuit input device at half the tail current; its ro sets the NMOS-side cascoded output resistance.

doc.title: Input (NMOS) cascode
doc.description: Cascodes the input device; its intrinsic gain av0 multiplies the input ro to set the NMOS-side Rout.

doc.title: Load (PMOS) cascode
doc.description: Cascodes the load mirror; its intrinsic gain av0 multiplies the mirror ro to set the PMOS-side Rout.

doc.title: Load mirror device
doc.description: One side of the PMOS load mirror at half the tail current; its ro (cascoded by casc_p) sets the PMOS-side output resistance.

doc.title: Tail current source
doc.description: Carries the full bias current; its vdsat is the extra headroom below the input source node.

rows.name: Rout_n
rows.note: NMOS-side output resistance: input ro boosted by the input-cascode intrinsic gain

rows.name: Rout_p
rows.note: PMOS-side output resistance: mirror ro boosted by the load-cascode intrinsic gain

rows.name: Rout
rows.note: the two cascoded sides in parallel

rows.name: vn_in
rows.note: input pair plus load-mirror density; the cascodes add little (they carry the same current at low gm relative to the pair)

rows.name: vos
rows.expr: sqrt(pelgrom_vos(avt, abeta, in__W, L_in, gm_id_in)^2 + (pelgrom_vos(avt, abeta, mir__W, L_mir, gm_id_mir)*mir__gm/in__gm)^2)
rows.note: input-pair offset plus the load mirror's offset referred by the gm ratio

rows.name: swing
rows.note: rail minus the four stacked cascode vdsat minus the tail headroom: the total output swing budget

rules.note: the stacked headroom must leave at least the peak-to-peak output swing
estimate: the NMOS-side node drops (tail node + input vds + input-cascode vds) must reach the output DC; retune the vds estimates
estimate: the PMOS-side node drops (load-cascode vds + mirror vds) must reach VDD from the output DC
the tail-node placement uses vgs_est_in; retune it to the reported in__vgs if this trips
